notes: The key fix: capitalization applies to the literal first character of the raw string (before whitespace removal), not to the first character after stripping. So a leading space blocks capitalization entirely — `"  hello there"` → `"hellothere"`, not `"Hellothere"`. This also correctly explains E1's `"  spaced  "` → `"spaced"` and E3's `"  a  b  "` → `"ab"`.
